<thought>The mass spectrum shows a clear isotopic envelope with peaks spaced by ~1 Da and relative intensities (M+1 ≈ 11 %, M+2 ≈ 1 %, etc.) that match the natural 13C distribution for a molecule containing about ten carbons. No characteristic M+2 ≈ 30 % (Cl) or M+2 ≈ 100 % (Br) patterns are present, and other elements have much smaller isotope contributions. Therefore, carbon is the only element that can be definitively identified from the observed pattern.</thought>
<final_answer>['C']</final_answer>
